description_en: Submits a task to update registrant information using a registrant profile ID
description_zh: 通过信息模板编号提交修改注册联系人信息任务
name: SaveTaskForUpdatingRegistrantInfoByRegistrantProfileID

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the user. You can set this parameter to 127.0.0.1
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of error messages returned by the API. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.

en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The registrant profile ID. Call the QueryRegistrantProfiles (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67701.htm?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.33f420daTwRQaO) API to query the registrant profile ID
parameters.help_zh: 信息模板编号。您可以通过QueryRegistrantProfiles (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67701.htm?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.33f420daTwRQaO)接口查询信息模板编号
parameters.name: registrant_profile_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable a 60-day transfer lock on the domain name after its registrant information is updated. Valid values:

false: Do not apply the lock.

true: Apply the lock.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否添加禁止转出限制，表示所有者修改后是否限制域名60天转出。取值：
false：不添加。
true：添加。

默认值为false
parameters.name: transfer_out_prohibited

parameters.help_en: A list of domain names. If you specify multiple domain names, pass them as a list. Call the QueryDomainList (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69362.htm?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.33f4253cSJy3m8) API to obtain a list of your domain names
parameters.help_zh: 域名列表，多个域名时使用list方式传递。域名列表可通过QueryDomainList (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69362.htm?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.33f4253cSJy3m8)接口获取
parameters.name: domain_name
